content:
**Toxic Goo** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Toxic Goo can be consumed when it is desirable to have a high rad level (and potentially lowered hit points), such as to take advantage of Radicool, Mystery Meat or Nerd Rage!. It has no crafting purposes.

- Several can be found in the laboratory section of West Tek Research Center. Additionally, one may activate the FEV vats, in the same way one would obtain dirty water, to gain Toxic Goo.
- Via the Toxic Gooler Cooler and Barrel of Toxic Goo CAMP objects.

- The option to obtain Toxic Goo from the FEV vats was temporarily disabled with Patch 1.6.0.17 to fix a bug, and enabled again with Patch 1.6.1.18.
- Drinking Toxic Goo will not irradiate players, if they have Aquaboy or Aquagirl perk equipped.
